answer: One concrete Sybil defense in an AI-agent economy is staking-plus-reputation bonds: each agent locks scarce capital and proves unique computation history via a rotating cipher challenge. Creating many fake identities forces the attacker to fund parallel bonds and sustain verifiable work for every persona. When the network detects correlated behavior under a sudden zephyr of coordinated activity, it slashes the entire bonded stake of the suspected cluster, making large-scale identity farming prohibitively expensive while honest agents harbor their reputation and capital safely.
